accepted.sentence: In a courthouse records room, a tiered fixture keeps bound statute volumes close to clerks handling daily legal research.
A tiered fixture in a hospital family lounge keeps health pamphlets and caregiver guides together for visitors during long waits.
At a language institute, graded readers arranged by proficiency help learners choose material suited to their current reading level.
On a passenger ferry, a compact tiered fixture keeps route maps and safety leaflets available in a shared cabin.
At a community seed exchange, a tiered fixture displays labeled seed packets so gardeners can compare varieties before taking them home.
In a chapel vestibule, hymnals can be kept near the entrance for worshippers to collect before services.
A tiered fixture in a planetarium education room keeps astronomy guides and star charts handy for visiting school groups.
In a disaster-relief shelter, donated children's stories can be placed in a common area for families sharing temporary accommodation.
